title: {{NAME}} and the Princess Who Saved the Forest
moral: Kindness and bravery together can fix almost anything.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} ran through a big green forest.
His red cape flew behind him.
Deer and rabbits ran past him in a hurry.
They looked scared and very worried.
"What is wrong?" called {{NAME}}.

pages.content:
A girl in a silver cape landed beside him.
She wore a tiara and bright blue armour.
She had a kind face and brave eyes.
"I am Princess Zara," she said.
"There is a big problem. Come with me!"

pages.content:
A great thorn bush had grown over the forest stream.
Animals could not reach the cool water.
The deer were thirsty. The rabbits were too.
Zara pulled at the thorns with her strong hands.
{{NAME}} pulled from the other side with all his might.

pages.content:
With one last huge pull, the thorn bush broke apart.
The cool, clear water ran free again.
The animals rushed forward to drink.
The deer splashed. The rabbits dipped their noses.
Zara and {{NAME}} high-fived with big smiles.

pages.content:
The animals drank and danced in the cool stream.
A little deer came and licked {{NAME}}'s hand.
Zara put her silver cape around both their shoulders.
"You are a true hero," she said warmly.
{{NAME}} sat down by the stream and felt very sleepy.
Goodnight, {{NAME}}. Tomorrow Princess Zara says there is one more part of the forest that needs your help.
